text: SX Bet REST is wired into the app and the GitHub engine and pushed (full tests green): Settings > SX Bet (key + switch), also under Settings > APIs; engine secret SXBET_API_KEY ('Send my API keys' covers it); SX is now a default sharp book. It prices nothing until you add a read-only key (sx.bet > Account > API, scope 'Market data: read' only). Next: the WebSocket (live odds + scores) and the live lane. This ships in the next release.
